findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?src=mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: treppenlift_fakten · Public sink: treppenlift_kosten_schaetzen.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: treppenlift_fakten · Public sink: treppenlift_kosten_schaetzen

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
